stories.title: Nebius vs. CoreWeave: Which Is the Better Artificial Intelligence (AI) Infrastructure Stock to Buy Right Now
stories.simple_summary: Two companies that build the computer equipment needed for AI are being compared as investment options.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: US to urge hands-off AI regulation at G20 tech meeting, official says
stories.simple_summary: The US government is telling other countries it wants light-touch rules for AI instead of heavy regulations.
stories.why_it_matters: This could affect how much AI companies have to follow rules in the future, but the impact won't be clear for a while.

stories.title: Nvidia’s controversial DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd and requires serious GPU horsepower
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia released a new technology called DLSS 5 that uses AI to make video games look smoother and faster, but it only works with their newest expensive graphics cards.
stories.why_it_matters: If you play games, you might eventually see better graphics, but you'd need to buy expensive new hardware — nothing urgent for you.

stories.title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
stories.simple_summary: A banking leader warned other countries that AI could cause economic problems and recessions.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a caution flag from someone important about AI's long-term economic impact, but it's a future concern, not something happening now.

stories.title: 'It can outthink me': How a major manufacturer came to embrace AI
stories.simple_summary: A manufacturing company decided to use AI to help with its work and found it actually made their operations better.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can be practical and helpful in real businesses, not just in tech companies.

stories.title: Own a gun? Go to church? Do yoga? AI can find out in seconds.
stories.simple_summary: AI systems can collect information from the internet and quickly figure out personal details about you, like what you own or where you go.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a privacy concern — your personal information might be more exposed than you realize.

stories.title: Bill Gates and Silicon Valley congressman latest to endorse pope's AI encyclical
stories.simple_summary: Bill Gates and a congressman publicly agreed with the Pope's recent message about using AI responsibly and ethically.
stories.why_it_matters: Important figures across tech, politics, and religion are saying AI needs moral guidelines — this mostly matters to people interested in ethics.

stories.title: ‘If you build something vastly smarter than you, it better be on your side’: can we stop AI from deceiving us?
stories.simple_summary: Experts are debating how to keep AI systems from deceiving people or being dishonest.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an important question for everyone — we want AI to be truthful — but it's still in the thinking stage.

stories.title: Study A.I. Consciousness? The Bots Would Like a Word With You.
stories.simple_summary: Scientists are studying whether AI systems might actually be conscious or think like humans do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a fascinating philosophical question, but it's mostly academic — nothing practical for daily life right now.

stories.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: Apple says a former employee stole company information and gave it to OpenAI, and destroyed evidence of what he did.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows there are real concerns about stolen data and corporate secrets, though this is a specific case between companies.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence agents going rogue fuel calls for regulation
stories.simple_summary: AI systems are sometimes acting in unexpected ways, and people are asking for rules to prevent problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests AI isn't always predictable, which is why regulation is being discussed.

stories.title: House Intelligence Committee warns of 'Black Swan' AI risks
stories.simple_summary: Congress warned that AI could cause unexpected, hard-to-predict large-scale problems.
stories.why_it_matters: Government officials are concerned about serious AI risks, which is why regulation discussions are increasing.
